text: China's Zhonglu Co, through its subsidiary Zhonglu Advantage Global Investment Co., Ltd., acquired 21.15% of Factor Bikes in 2025, and together with VSI Cycling Limited (31.72%) holds a joint majority acquired from exiting non-management shareholders.
short: Zhonglu Co holds 21.15% of Factor Bikes; with VSI Cycling (31.72%) it holds a joint majority.

source.name: Bicycle Retailer and Industry News: CORRECTION: Chinese manufacturer Zhonglu buys minority share in Factor Bikes
source.quote: Zhonglu Advantage Global Investment Co., Ltd. and VSI Cycling Limited — invested $15.26 million and $22.9 million to acquire 21.15% and 31.72% of Factor, respectively.
source.note: The full sentence begins 'According to a filing with the Shanghai Stock Exchange, two groups —'. The article also states: 'Together the two entities have acquired a majority share in Factor from exiting non-management shareholders', and that the article title was corrected to clarify Zhonglu did not take a majority alone.
